candidate.name: Subrat Rout
candidate.headline: Support Engineer | Production Incident Management | Python Automation | AWS | Linux
candidate.professional_summary: Production Support Engineer with nearly 3 years of experience supporting enterprise applications in production environments, with strengths in incident management, Linux/Unix and Oracle troubleshooting, SQL, Python automation, REST API validation, batch-job operations, change/release validation, and root-cause analysis. Experienced owning incidents through resolution, maintaining operational documentation, and collaborating with development, DBA, QA, and DevOps teams.

experience.title: Product Support Engineer
responsibilities: L2 production support for enterprise Workforce Management applications across Oracle databases and Linux/Unix servers
Incident classification, prioritization, ServiceNow ticket management, status communication, escalation, and SLA monitoring
Troubleshooting application failures, batch-processing issues, data inconsistencies, and performance problems
Application-versus-database validation, SQL/PLSQL investigation, and log analysis
Problem-management and root-cause analysis activities with development, DBA, QA, and DevOps teams
Python automation for production health checks, log parsing, ServiceNow reporting, Control-M job validation, and release verification
Control-M job and dependency troubleshooting, failed-job investigation, rerun and validation activities
Change and release support including pre-deployment checks, deployment validation, smoke testing, post-deployment verification, and rollback checks
REST API validation using Postman and Python, JSON response checks, SQL verification, and post-release monitoring
SOPs, runbooks, knowledge-base/known-error guidance, troubleshooting documentation, shift handovers, and mentoring

experience.title: Technical Operations Analyst
responsibilities: Technical point of contact for operational issues using Salesforce for investigation, escalation, resolution tracking, and closure
Investigation across data, application, process, and user areas including RCA, data reconciliation, data-quality checks, and duplicate/inconsistent-record investigation
Operational reporting and data validation using Python, SQL, Power Query, and Excel
KPI/SLA reporting and recurring operational reports
Power BI dashboards for operational reporting and validation
Reporting requirements and process improvement
REST API testing, UAT, fix validation, production/change validation, workflow documentation, technical issue/resolution documentation, and SOPs
Engineering escalation, resolution tracking, and guidance on operational processes and tools

experience.title: Technical Support Representative
responsibilities: Broadband, voice, and networking troubleshooting across TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, modem provisioning, and router/modem configuration
IP configuration/renewal, connectivity diagnostics, remote device checks, and signal/status validation
CRM case management, troubleshooting documentation, escalation, and follow-up
First-level root-cause isolation using troubleshooting decision trees and knowledge bases
Technical troubleshooting guides and knowledge-base content
Personal Linux home lab and Python log-analysis scripts for technical-support skill development
